coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 6 of 11 ground-truth items (55%): all three prompting methods and all three tasks. The required controls and exact inference-time metric are not matched.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Specifies 2x/4x A100-80GB GPUs rather than an NVIDIA A100-PCIE-40GB GPU, and 3 runs rather than 10 repeated runs per task. Fixed random seeds and a shared framework installation/BoT repository configuration are not specified. Measures raw latency rather than base-10 logarithmic inference time per instance. Also adds CoT and several metrics absent from the ground truth.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Provides neither the expected overall increase in BoT inference time nor the task-specific logarithmic timing values, including the exception that BoT is faster than PAL on Game of 24.
